name: Kodo Liver
summary: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn needs Kodo Liver for a strange ale. He learned to brew trogg ale from the wandering brewmaster Chen Stormstout.

sections.title: A Bizarre Brewing Reagent
sections.body: Kodos roam the Barrens, where tauren and predators hunt them for their hides and meat. In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn uses a fresh Kodo Liver with thunderhawk saliva glands and lightning glands to make trogg ale. Chen Stormstout taught Drohn the recipe, and Drohn says the blend packs a potent kick for adventurous travelers. The ingredients come from the wilds of central Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is a Kodo Liver used for?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet uses Kodo Liver in trogg ale. Chen Stormstout taught him the recipe.

faq.q: Which creatures yield a Kodo Liver?
faq.answer: Kodo Liver comes from kodos in the Barrens, including common, wooly, lost, and greater kodos, as well as Lakota'mani and Brontus.

faq.q: Why would anyone put animal organs in ale?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn follows the eccentric recipes Chen Stormstout taught him. In trogg ale, raw organs such as Kodo Liver and elemental glands give the drink its kick and sharp flavor.

angles.text: Kodo meat feeds people across central Kalimdor, but Kodo Liver is considered too foul and pungent for ordinary cooking. Its use in Ratchet's trogg ale has made it notorious.
Tauren honor every part of the kodo they hunt. Even seasoned plainsrunners look askance at goblins and foreigners who make novelty ale from kodo innards in Ratchet.
